posts.community: Swastika Castal Ltd - Powering Substations via Aluminium Castings
posts.text: Yes, They have an order book of around 20-22 Crores- It’s scheduled based so it is next 4-6 months visibility. Another peer got recently listed- Poojaa Precision Engineering- Their Energy vertical has similar clientele and a domestic exposure to the GIS OEMs- Siemens, Hitachi, Hyusong and the likes. The components made by Poojaa are much heavier vs Swastika as Poojaa has a great casting setup with major focus on Gravity Die Casting which is a little more critical and fetches better margins vs Low Pressure Die Casting and High Pressure Die Castings. Swastika is a smaller- energy portfolio focus…
